name: PAINPAL
source:
You lost everything. Your daughter, lost in an instant. Drowning in grief and alcohol, you were trapped in the past, until he came with an offer.

The Devil makes you an offer: sow enough despair, and he will bring her back.

Now, you have a choice. How far are you willing to go? How much suffering will you spread to rewrite the past?

There is no time to think. There is only forward.

[From [url=https://mimico-studio.itch.io/painpal]itch.io[/url]]
